run_ImageReadBench: run the ImageReadBench benchmark to measure FFCV image read performance with configurable parameters
create_DummyDataset: create a DummyDataset that generates random uint8 images of a specified size and length
review_ImageReadBench_enter: review the ImageReadBench __enter__ method that sets up DatasetWriter, Reader, and OSCacheManager
test_DummyDataset_getitem: test the DummyDataset __getitem__ method to verify it returns random image data for valid indices
summarize_benchmark_decorator: summarize the benchmark decorator that parameterizes ImageReadBench with n, mode, size, and num_workers
